answer: Sybil resistance can be priced with a convex endorsement market. Each identity must collect attestations from peers in a different social cluster, and attesting to a cluster gets harder as that cluster already vouches for more identities, so n clones under one cluster pay n times what a lone agent pays. Attestations bind into a spiral of hashes, each link committing to the one before, so a forked roster cannot reuse the same proofs. Weight also needs a pigment, a non-transferable token of independent work history, and a knoll, a scarce anchor only one holder can possess, neither poolable.
